description:
We’re a team of three engineers who believe 3:15 is the perfect time: the clock hands are almost aligned, like the Sun, Earth and Moon before a good landing.

We’re building a CLPS Lunar Mission Browser that makes choosing where and when to land on the Moon as easy as booking a weekend getaway.

We bring computer vision, 3D and multi-view geometry, deep math, coding and system design expertise, data science from spreadsheets to multimodal LLMs, and peak productivity at 3:15 AM.
